title: The Installment Still Owed on a Home Comfort Financing Account
content:
*Customer care desk guidance — Home Comfort Financing installments.*

The installment still owed on a Home Comfort Financing account is measured by what happened to the most recent payment: where it was returned, the returned payment counts as never made and the full monthly payment is owed; where it was not returned and the payments posted less than one whole month before the date of handling, less the returned payments posted in that time, came to more than zero but less than the monthly payment, the monthly payment less those payments is owed; otherwise the monthly payment less the payments posted in that month is owed, never below zero.

**Meanings.** The most recent payment *was returned* when a returned-payment entry on the account is dated on or after the posting date of the most recent payment. *The payments posted in that month* are the payment entries posted less than one whole month before the date of handling; *the returned payments posted in that time* are the amounts of the returned-payment entries posted in the same span.

## Input — judgement — output

| Most recent payment | Payments less returned payments in the last month | Installment still owed |
|---|---|---|
| returned | any | the full monthly payment |
| not returned | above zero and below the monthly payment | the monthly payment less (payments less returned payments) |
| not returned | any other figure (zero or less, or at least the monthly payment) | the monthly payment less the payments posted in that month, never below zero |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, monthly payment $238.47)

1. A $238.47 autopay draft posted 10 days ago was returned 4 days ago. The most recent payment was returned: $238.47 is owed.
2. Payments of $50.00 and then $100.00 posted in the last month; the $50.00 payment was returned before the $100.00 payment posted. The most recent payment was not returned. Payments less returned payments: $150.00 less $50.00, that is $100.00 — above zero and below $238.47 — so $138.47 is owed.
3. Not returned; nothing paid in the last month: $238.47 is owed.
4. Not returned; $250.00 paid in the last month: $238.47 less $250.00 is below zero, so nothing is owed.
